Xestospongia testudinaria adalah spesies spons yang tergolong dalam kelas Demospongiae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari kelas Demospongiae, filum Porifera, subregnum Parazoa, dan kingdom Animalia.
Danaus affinis, the Malay tiger, mangrove tiger or swamp tiger, is a butterfly found in tropical Asia. It belongs to the "crows and tigers", the danaine group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Xylocopa latipes, the tropical carpenter bee, is a species of carpenter bee widely dispersed throughout Southeast Asia. As its name suggests, this bee inhabits forests in warm tropical climates and constructs nests by burrowing into wood.

species.name: Kupu-Kupu Gajah
species.summary: Kupu-kupu gajah (Attacus atlas) adalah sejenis ngengat bertubuh besar yang menyebar luas di wilayah tropika dan subtropika Asia Tenggara; umum ditemukan di Kepulauan Nusantara. Dalam bahasa Inggris ia dikenal sebagai Atlas moth.

Coccinella transversalis, commonly known as the transverse ladybird or transverse lady beetle is a species of ladybird beetle found from India across southern and southeastern Asia to Malesia and Australia.

Danaus genutia, the common tiger, is one of the common butterflies of India. It belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the Danainae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. The butterfly is also called striped tiger in India to differentiate it from the equally common plain tiger, Danaus chrysippus.
Cupha erymanthis, the rustic, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia. The males and females are identical.

Vespa velutina, yang dikenal juga sebagai tawon berkaki kuning atau tawon predator asia, adalah spesies tawon yang berasal dari Asia Tenggara. Spesies ini menjadi perhatian karena sifatnya yang invasif di beberapa negara lain, terutama di sebagian besar wilayah Eropa. V.
Jamides celeno, the common cerulean, is a small butterfly found in Southeast Asia belonging to the lycaenids or blues family.
Tylorida ventralis is a species of long-jawed orb weaver spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It has a wide distribution ranging from Pakistan and India to Japan, Taiwan, and New Guinea.

Cyrtophora moluccensis adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1857 oleh Doleschall.

Argiope catenulata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

species.name: Tawon Kendi
species.summary: Tawon endas atau tawon ndas (Vespa affinis) adalah tabuhan yang banyak terdapat di Asia tropis dan subtropis. Umumnya dikenal sebagai tawon Vespa, tawon ini disebut sebagai tawon endas (dari bahasa Jawa endhas "kepala") karena sarang tawon ini terbuat dari tanah atau lumpur yang berbentuk seperti kepala.

Cosmophasis thalassina adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cosmophasis dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1846 oleh C L Koch.

Luthrodes pandava (formerly Chilades pandava), the plains Cupid or cycad blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, United Arab Emirates, Indochina, Peninsular Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan, Java, Sumatra and the Philippines.

Argiope versicolor adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

species.name: Cucak Bersisik
species.summary: The scaly-breasted bulbul (Pycnonotus squamatus) is a species of songbird in the bulbul family. It is found from the Malay Peninsula to Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Delias hyparete, the painted Jezebel, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, found in South Asia and Southeast Asia.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan

species.summary: Euthalia aconthea, the common baron, often called simply baron, is a medium-sized nymphalid butterfly native to India and South-East Asia. It flies with stiff wing beats and often glides. The wing is not flapped very far below the horizontal.
Prosotas nora, the common lineblue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Asia.
Asota heliconia is a moth in the Erebidae family. It is found from the Indo-Australian tropics east to Queensland and the Solomons.

Graphium doson, the common jay, is a black, tropical papilionid (swallowtail) butterfly with pale blue semi-transparent central wing bands that are formed by large spots. There is a marginal series of smaller spots. The underside of wings is brown with markings similar to upperside but whitish in colour.

Theretra oldenlandiae, the impatiens hawkmoth or taro hornworm, is a member of the family Sphingidae found in India, Sri Lanka, China, Borneo, Japan, the Philippines, Thailand, and Australia. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1775.

Gasteracantha diardi adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1835 oleh Lucas. Laba-laba ini biasanya banyak ditemui di Tiongkok, Thailand, Malaysia, dan Kepulauan Sunda.
Hypolimnas anomala, the Malayan eggfly or crow eggfly (Chinese: 畸紋紫斑蛺蝶) is a species of eggfly.
The palm weevil Rhynchophorus vulneratus is one of two species of snout beetle known as the red palm weevil or Asian palm weevil.
Hypolycaena erylus, the common tit, is a small but striking butterfly found in India and South-East Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Graphium eurypylus, the great jay or pale green triangle, is a species of tropical butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae.
Papilio demolion, the banded swallowtail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in Asia.
Appias lyncida, the chocolate albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in South and South East Asia.

species.name: Penggulung Daun Pisang
species.summary: Erionota thrax yang umumnya diketahui dengan nama ulat penggulung daun pisang adalah termasuk anggota kupu-kupu yang terdapat dalam familia Hesperiidae. Ia ditemukan dari India, Asia Tenggara hingga Papua New Guinea. Lalu, ke arah China Selatan.
Euploea algea adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae.
Vindula dejone, the Malay cruiser, is a butterfly from the family Nymphalidae found in Southeast Asia. It is sexually dimorphic.
Trilophidia annulata is a species of band-winged grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Asia.
Amathusia phidippus, the palmking, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the Satyrinae, a subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies.

species.name: Kangkok Besar
species.summary: Kangkok besar (Hierococcyx sparverioides) adalah spesies pada familia tekukur, kangkok, dan sejenisnya yaitu cuculidae.
Parmarion martensi is a species of air-breathing land semislug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Ariophantidae.
Hebomoia glaucippe, the great orange tip, is a butterfly belonging to the family Pieridae, that is the yellows and whites. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone and Wallacea.
Dolichoderus thoracicus is a species of ant in the genus Dolichoderus. Described by Smith in 1860, the species is widespread in Asia.
Euthalia monina, the powdered baron or Malay baron is a species of nymphalid butterfly.

Parawixia dehaani adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.
Phimenes flavopictus is a species of Potter wasp found from India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, China, Myanmar, Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia.
Belalang semut (Odontomantis planiceps) adalah salah satu spesies belalang sembah yang umum ditemukan di Asia.

Conocephalus melaenus, sometimes known as the black-kneed conehead or black-kneed meadow katydid is a species of Tettigoniidae found in China, Taiwan, Japan, Nepal, India, Indo-China and western Malesia.

Faunis canens, the common faun, is a butterfly from South and South East Asia that belongs to the Morphinae, a subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies. This species may include the Indian faun, Faunis arcesilaus.
The Grass Demon Udaspes folus is a small but prominent butterfly found in India that belongs to the Skippers, or Hesperiidae family. It is regarded as an occasional pest of ginger and turmeric.
Gesonula mundata is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Southeast Asia and Oceania.
The red-rimmed melania, scientific name Melanoides tuberculata, is a species of freshwater snail with an operculum, a parthenogenetic, aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Thiaridae.

species.name: Kerbau
species.summary: Kerbau, atau yang biasa disebut kebo, benuang atau kerbau air (untuk membedakannya dengan kerbau afrika), adalah binatang memamah biak yang menjadi ternak bagi banyak bangsa di dunia, terutama Asia dan Amerika Selatan.
Ypthima baldus, the common five-ring, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.

Henosepilachna vigintioctopunctata is a species of beetle in the family Coccinellidae. It is commonly known as the 28-spotted potato ladybird or the Hadda beetle. It feeds on the foliage of potatoes and other solanaceous crops. It was previously called Epilachna vigintioctopunctata and is a cryptic species complex.

species.name: Tawon Sengat Kuning
species.summary: Vespa analis, the yellow-vented hornet, is a species of common hornet found in Southeast Asia.

Vespa tropica, the greater banded hornet, is a tropical species of hornet found in Southern Asia, new Guinea and west Africa, and which has recently been discovered to be an invasive species on the Pacific Island of Guam. It is a predator of paper wasps.

Lamproptera meges, the green dragontail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly (family Papilionidae) found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. There are ten subspecies. A specimen from Java is the type species of the genus.

Drain flies, sink flies, filter flies, or sewer gnats (Psychodidae) are small true flies (Diptera) with short, hairy bodies and wings giving them a "furry" moth-like appearance, hence one of their common names, moth flies. There are more than 4,700 known species worldwide, most of them native to the humid tropics.
Penthicodes farinosus is a species of planthoppers in the subfamily Aphaeninae (Fulgoridae): with five subspecies distributed in Indo-China and Malesia.
Delias belisama is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1779. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Telostylinus lineolatus, atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kalisao dalam bahasa Sea-Sea, adalah sebuah spesies lalat dari genus Telostylinus. Hewan ini dideskripsikan pertama kali oleh Christian Rudolph Wilhelm Wiedemann pada tahun 1830.
Symbrenthia hypselis, the Himalayan jester, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia, and some islands in South East Asia (Sumatra, Java)
Agrius convolvuli, the convolvulus hawk-moth, is a large hawk-moth. It is common throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia and New Zealand, partly as a migrant.
Nyctemera baulus is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from India to Samoa. Records include Queensland, Indonesia and New Guinea.
Xylocopa dejeanii, or Xylocopa (Zonohirsuta) dejeanii, is a species of carpenter bee. It is widely distributed in Asian countries....
Chersonesia rahria is an Indomalayan butterfly of the Nymphalidae family (Cyrestinae). It is found from Manipur and Naga Hills to Burma then from Borneo to Celebes.
Delta pyriforme is a species of potter wasp in the subfamily Eumeninae of the family Vespidae.

Aedes aegypti merupakan jenis nyamuk yang dapat membawa virus dengue penyebab penyakit demam berdarah. Selain dengue, A. aegypti juga merupakan pembawa virus demam kuning (yellow fever), chikungunya, dan demam Zika yang disebabkan oleh virus Zika.
Cyrestis acilia is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Sulawesi (Endemic Sulawesi mainland, Buton island, Kabaena island and Wowoni island).
Elymnias nesaea, atau kupu-kupu tiger palmfly, adalah spesies kupu-kupu dalam famili Nymphalidae.
Ypthima philomela, the baby fivering or baby fourring, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.

Catopsilia scylla, the orange migrant or orange emigrant, is a species of butterfly that lives in South East Asia and Australasia. Its larvae feed predominantly on plants of the genera Cassia and Senna.

The longhorn crazy ant (Paratrechina longicornis), also known as "black crazy ant", is a species of small, dark-coloured insect in the family Formicidae. These ants are commonly called "crazy ants" because instead of following straight lines, they dash around erratically.
Spalgis epeus, the apefly, is a small butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family. It gets its name from the supposed resemblance of its caterpillar to the face of an ape.
Banded Treebrown (Lethe confusa), adalah sebuah spesies kupu-kupu yang masuk dalam kelompok Satyrinae yang ditemukan di Asia Tenggara dan sebagian Asia Selatan.
Nacaduba berenice, the rounded six-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Southeast Asia.
Phintelloides versicolor is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. Originally described from Bintan Island in Indonesia, it is widely distributed across tropical Southeast Asia.

Plexippus paykulli adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Plexippus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1826 oleh Audouin.
Yoma sabina, the Australian lurcher, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in the north of the Australasia ecozone and Southeast Asia.
Macracantha hasselti is a species of spider belonging to the family Araneidae. It is a native of Asia, occurring from India eastwards to Indonesia.
Megisba malaya, the Malayan, is a small butterfly found in South Asia. It belongs to the family of gossamer-winged butterflies (Lycaenidae).

Crossopriza lyoni is a widespread species of cellar spiders that prefer to live in or around human structures. They are commonly known as tailed cellar spiders, tailed daddy longlegs spiders, and sometimes box spiders.

Phintella vittata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Phintella dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1846 oleh C L Koch.
Telamonia festiva is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. It is widely distributed across South and Southeast Asia, from India to the Philippines.

Burung hantu gudang timur (Tyto javanica) adalah burung hantu yang biasanya dianggap sebagai kelompok subspesies dan, bersama dengan kelompok burung hantu gudang Amerika, kelompok burung hantu gudang barat, serta kadang burung hantu bertopeng Andaman, membentuk genus Tyto.

Polyura athamas, the common nawab, is a species of fast-flying canopy butterfly found in tropical Asia. It belongs to the Charaxinae (rajahs and nawabs) in the brush-footed butterfly family (Nymphalidae).
Zemeros flegyas, the Punchinello, is a small butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia that belongs to the Riodinidae family.

Trigoniulus corallinus, sometimes called the rusty millipede, is a species of millipede widely distributed in the Indo-Malayan region including India, Sri Lanka, China, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore, and much of Indonesia.
Liocheles australasiae, the Dwarf Wood Scorpion, is a species of scorpions belonging to the family Hemiscorpiidae.

species.name: Elang kelelawar
species.summary: Elang kelelawar (Macheiramphus alcinus) adalah spesies burung pemangsa dalam famili Accipitridae. Burung ini tersebar di Afrika, Asia Tenggara, dan Papua Nugini. Di Indonesia burung ini dapat ditemui di wilayah Sumatra, Kalimantan, dan Sulawesi.

Parthenos sylvia, the clipper, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South and South-East Asia, mostly in forested areas. The clipper is a fast-flying butterfly and has a habit of flying with its wings flapping stiffly between the horizontal position and a few degrees below the horizontal.
Thorelliola ensifera is a species of jumping spider of the genus Thorelliola. Originally native to Southeast Asia, it has been widely introduced to tropical islands across the Pacific Ocean.
Papilio ascalaphus, the Ascalaphus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found in Indonesia and the Philippines.

The Atlas beetle, Chalcosoma atlas (Thai: ด้วงกว่างสามเขาเขาใหญ่) is a very large species of beetle in the family Scarabaeidae, found in Southeast Asia. Males have three prominent horns. The species is named for Atlas, the giant of Greek mythology who supported the skies.

Chlorophorus annularis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Chlorophorus, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Cyrestis lutea, the orange straight-line map-wing or little map-wing, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Indonesia.
Catopsilia pyranthe, the mottled emigrant, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae found in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and parts of Australia.
Graphium antiphates, the five-bar swordtail, is a species of papilionid butterfly found in south and southeast Asia. The species was first described by Pieter Cramer in 1775.

The Common fruit-piercing moth, (Eudocima phalonia), is a fruit piercing moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in large parts of the tropics, mainly in Asia, Africa and Australia but introduced into other areas such as Hawaii, New Zealand and the Society Islands. It is one of major fruit pests in the world.

The Darth Maul bug (Spilostethus hospes), is a species of seed bug found in Asia, Australasia, and Oceania. Its common name is a reference to the Star Wars character Darth Maul, who shares similar markings.
Udara dilecta, the prized hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in India, China, and Malaya that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Ariadne ariadne, the angled castor, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.

Epepeotes luscus is a species of beetle in the family Cerambycidae. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1787. It is known from Malaysia, China, Indonesia, Cambodia, Myanmar, the Nicobar and Solomon Islands, Laos, Thailand, India, and Vietnam. It feeds on Mangifera indica.
Lexias pardalis, the common archduke, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family.
Phalanta alcippe, the small leopard, is a butterfly of the nymphalid or brush-footed butterfly family found in Asia.

species.summary: Thiania bhamoensis is a species of jumping spider.

Zeltus is a butterfly genus in the family Lycaenidae, the blues. It is monotypic containing the species Zeltus amasa, the fluffy tit, a small butterfly found in India. The wingspan is 28–32 millimeter.
Asota egens is a species of noctuoid moths in the Erebidae family. It is found from Japan and the Oriental tropics, east to New Guinea.
Catopyrops ancyra, or Felder's lineblue, is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Cajetan Felder in 1860. It is found in the Indomalayan and Australasian realms.

species.name: Kupu-kupu bidadari
species.summary: Kupu-kupu bidadari atau kupu-kupu sayap renda (nama ilmiah: Cethosia myrina) adalah kupu-kupu dari famili Nymphalidae. Kupu-kupu ini ditemukan di Pulau Sulawesi dan Buton. Lebar sayap kupu-kupu ini adalah 75 mm.
Pantoporia hordonia merupakan spesies kupu-kupu dari famili Nymphalidae yang tersebar di wilayah tropis dan subtropis Asia, termasuk Kamboja.
Lethe europa, the bamboo treebrown, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.
Lyncina lynx, common name : the lynx cowry or eyed cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Melanitis phedima, the dark evening brown, is a species of butterfly found flying at dusk. The flight of this species is erratic. They are found in South Asia.
Parantica aspasia, the yellow glassy tiger, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Ptocasius weyersi adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Ptocasius dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.
Euploea phaenareta, the giant crow is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Johann Gottlieb Schaller in 1785. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.

species.name: Tawon Bendera
species.summary: Evania appendigaster is a species of wasp in the family Evaniidae, the ensign wasps. Its native range is not known, but it likely originated in Asia. Today it occurs throughout the tropics and subtropics and in many temperate regions. It is a parasitoid wasp known for specializing on cockroaches.

The Metallic jumper, (Siler semiglaucus), also known as colorful jumping spider, or Jade jumping spider (玉翠蛛 : Chinese), is a species of spider of the genus Siler. It is found throughout India to Philippines.

Tirumala hamata, the blue tiger, dark blue tiger or blue wanderer, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in South-East Asia and Australia. In Australia, the butterflies perform mass migrations to the south in some years.
Stenocatantops splendens is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and eastern Asia.
Hidari irava, the coconut skipper, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in southern Myanmar, Thailand, western Malaysia, as well as on Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the Sula Islands.
Loxura atymnus, the yamfly, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.

Leptoglossus gonagra, known generally as the passionvine bug or citron bug, is a species of leaf-footed bug in the family Coreidae. It is found in Africa, Australia, the Caribbean, Central America, North America, Oceania, South America, and Southern Asia.
Cepora judith is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It has no common name, although a subspecies is referred to as the orange gull. It is found in south-eastern Asia (see subspecies section).

Nilus albocinctus, synonym Thalassius albocinctus, commonly called the fishing spider, is a species of spider found in tropical Asia from India to the Philippines. It is named after its habit of catching small fish.

Tylorida striata is a species of spider in the family Tetragnathidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1877. The species has a wide distribution across tropical Asia and northern Australia.
Heterometrus longimanus, the Black Emperor Scorpion or Asian forest scorpion, is a species of scorpions belonging to the family Scorpionidae.

Hippasa holmerae is a species of wolf spider in the family Lycosidae. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1895 based on specimens collected from Burma. The species is commonly known as the lawn wolf spider and has a wide distribution across Asia.

Hypolimnas alimena, the blue-banded eggfly, is a species of butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It is found in the Solomon Islands, Indonesia (Aru Islands, Irian Jaya, Kei Islands, Maluku), New Guinea and Australia (the coast of New South Wales, the Northern Territory and Queensland).

species.name: Walang Sangit
species.summary: Leptocorisa oratoria, the rice ear bug, is an insect from the family Alydidae, the broad-headed bugs. This species is commonly confused with Leptocorisa acuta, a similar and closely related species, called the rice earhead bug.

Papilio ulysses, the Ulysses butterfly (also commonly known as the Blue emperor), is a large swallowtail butterfly of Australia, Indonesia, Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands. Its size varies depending on subspecies, but the wingspan is about 10.5 cm (4.1 in) in Queensland.
Pseudoxya diminuta is an Asian species of grasshopper.
Rhinopalpa polynice, the wizard, is a nymphalid butterfly found in India and South Asia, and is the only species in the genus Rhinopalpa.

Symbrenthia lilaea, the common jester, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It forms a superspecies with Symbrenthia hippoclus and there are numerous regional forms and the taxonomy of the group is not well resolved.

Amplypterus panopus, the mango hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, southern and northern India (including the Andaman Islands and Nicobar Islands), Nepal, Burma, southern China, Thailand, Vietnam, Laos, Indonesia (to Sulawesi) and the Philippines.

Danaus melanippus, the black veined tiger, white tiger, common tiger, or eastern common tiger, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia which belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the danaine group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Scolopendra subspinipes (Vietnamese Centipede) is a species of centipede. The native range is uncertain. The certain natural range is Meganesia and Indomalaya.

species.name: Tonggeret Hijau
species.summary: Dundubia vaginata is the type species in its genus, sometimes called the jade-green cicada (Hemiptera: Cicadidae) in the tribe Dundubiini.

Pareronia valeria, the common wanderer or Malayan wanderer, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, and is found in India and Southeast Asia. The butterfly found in India is sometimes considered as a separate species, Pareronia hippia.

Euploea eunice, commonly called blue-banded king crow, is a butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Macracantha arcuata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1793 oleh Fabricius.
Mycalesis mineus, atau kupu-kupu Dark Brand Bush Brown, adalah kupu-kupu yang termasuk dalam famili Nymphalidae dan subfamili Satyrinae.

Oxyopes macilentus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Oxyopidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Oxyopes dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1878 oleh L Koch.
Papilio fuscus, the Canopus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae, that is found on Timor, northern Australia, and New Guinea.
Athyma nefte, the colour sergeant, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in tropical South and Southeast Asia.
Polyrhachis bicolor is a member of the camponotin ants in the genus Polyrhachis ranging from Australia to the tip of China.
Theretra nessus, the yam hawk moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Dru Drury in 1773.
Asota plana is a moth in the family Erebidae. It is found from the Oriental tropics east to New Guinea.
Celastrina lavendularis, the plain hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in Sri Lanka and South India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Notocrypta paralysos, the banded demon or common banded demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Pycanum rubens is a species of giant stink bug in the family Tessaratomidae. The species is widespread, and has been recorded in Borneo, Burma, China (Yunnan), India (Hindustan), Indonesia, Java, the Malay Peninsula, Moluccas, Philippines, Sumatra, and Vietnam.
Delias pasithoe, the redbase Jezebel is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites. The species is found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Euploea radamanthus, the magpie crow, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Leucauge decorata the decorative silver orb spider is one of the long-jawed orb weaver spiders. A medium to large sized orb weaving spider, with a body length up to 12 mm long (female). Male to 6 mm. This species has a "point" to the end of the abdomen. Found in Africa, India, south east Asia, also to Australia.
Papilio karna is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in Java, Sumatra, Borneo and the Philippines.
Athyma perius, the common sergeant, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Traulia azureipennis is a species of grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Southeast Asia.
Appias albina, the common albatross, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Daphnis nerii, the oleander hawk-moth or army green moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae.
Papilio nephelus is a species of swallowtail butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae. Subspecies include P. n. chaon, the yellow Helen, and P. n. sunatus, the black and white Helen.
Polyura hebe, the plain nawab, is a butterfly belonging to the brush-footed butterflies family (Nymphalidae).
Udara akasa, the white hedge blue, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Amphidromus palaceus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.

Daphnis hypothous, the jade hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1780. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and northern India, Nepal, Myanmar, southern China, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia. It is a rare vagrant to the Western Palaearctic ecozone.
Lexias dirtea, the archduke, is a species of butterfly of the family Nymphalidae.

Lyssa zampa, which is also known as the tropical swallowtail moth or the Laos brown butterfly, is a species of moth of the family Uraniidae. It can be found from Himalaya to Borneo and the Malay Peninsula.
Rapala iarbus, the common red flash, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia.

Ambulyx moorei (cinnamon gliding hawkmoth) is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sri Lanka, southern and eastern India, the Nicobar Islands and Andaman Islands, Thailand, Vietnam, southern China, the Philippines (Palawan, Balabac), Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak), Singapore and Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Kal…
Cassida circumdata is a species of tortoise beetle in the family Chrysomelidae. It is found in Indomalaya and the South Pacific islands.
Catochrysops panormus, the silver forget-me-not, is a small butterfly found from India to the Philippines and south to Australia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Oxya japonica, also known as the Japanese grasshopper or rice grasshopper, is a species of short-horned grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and eastern Asia.
Euthalia adonia is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Limenitidinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Tirumala septentrionis atau harimau biru tua, adalah kupu-kupu danaid yang ditemukan di anak benua India dan Asia Tenggara.
Polyrhachis dives is a wide-ranging species of ant from southern Asia and the Northern Territory of Australia.

Bavia sexpunctata adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Bavia dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

Euploea redtenbacheri, the Malayan crow or Redtenbacher's crow is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Appias olferna, the eastern striped albatross or Bengal albatross, is a butterfly in the Appias genus of the family Pieridae.
Orthomorpha coarctata atau dikenal dengan nama ulat gagak atau joyo gading adalah spesies kaki seribu dari famili Paradoxosomatidae. Hewan ini juga dikenal dengan nama long-flange millipede.

species.summary: The sweetpotato bug (Physomerus grossipes) is a species of hemipterans in the family Coreidae. Native to Southeast Asia, the species has immigrated to the Pacific Islands. Frequently laying its eggs on the same Leguminosae and Convolvulaceae plants on which it feeds, the female of P.
Idea stolli, the common tree nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia. There are twelve Idea species, of which five occur in West Malaysia.
Anthene emolus, the ciliate blue, is a small butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Ampittia dioscorides, the common bush hopper or simply bush hopper, is a butterfly found in India, China, Indochina and on to Borneo, Sumatra and Java belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Euploea sylvester, the double-branded crow, also known as the two-brand crow in Australia, is a butterfly found in South Asia, Southeast Asia and parts of Australia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Hypochrosis binexata is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Thailand.
Parantica agleoides, the dark glassy tiger, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Pycnoscelus indicus is a species of cockroach in the genus Pycnoscelus, family Blaberidae.

The Surinam cockroach or greenhouse cockroach (Pycnoscelus surinamensis) is a species of burrowing cockroach. It is a common plant pest endemic to the Indomalayan region that has spread to tropical and into subtropical regions around the world, and in isolated populations to temperate climates where protective habitat…

Kupu-kupu sayap oranye atau Appias nero (Inggris: Orange Albatross) adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu dari keluarga Pieridae. Spesies ini bisa ditemukan dari daerah India Utara, kepulauan Sunda, Filipina, dan Sulawesi.
Bactrocera albistrigata adalah spesies lalat yang tergolong famili Tephritidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Diptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Ceratina smaragdula, also known as Ceratina (Pithitis) smaragdula, is a species of green metallic bees belonging to the family Apidae, subfamily Xylocopinae.
The Triangular-striped moth, Chalciope mygdon is a moth of the Noctuidae family. It is found from the Oriental region to Sundaland.

Euploea tulliolus, the dwarf crow or small brown crow, is a butterfly found in the Solomon Islands, Malaysia, Taiwan, Vietnam, Singapore and Australia, that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family. It has a wingspan of about 4 to 8 centimeters....

Polyura schreiber, the blue nawab, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia. It belongs to the Charaxinae (rajahs and nawabs) in the brush-footed butterfly family (Nymphalidae). It occurs from south India and Assam through Myanmar, Tenasserim, and Southeast Asia to southern China and to Java, Indonesia.

Theretra silhetensis, the brown-banded hunter hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Francis Walker in 1856. It lives in Indo-Australia, India, Sri Lanka, Papua New Guinea, East Australia, Solomon Islands, Fiji Islands, Vanuatu Islands.
Vagrans is monotypic genus with the species vagrant (Vagrans egista) a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Apis andreniformis, or the black dwarf honey bee, is a relatively rare species of honey bee whose native habitat is the tropical and subtropical regions of Southeast Asia.

Boiga melanota atau ular cincin-emas barat, adalah salah satu spesies ular banjang terbesar di Asia. Ular ini ditemukan di Thailand, Malaysia Barat, Singapura, dan Indonesia ( Sumatra ). Ular ini berwarna hitam kebiruan mengkilap, ditandai dengan 40-50 garis kuning.

species.name: Kambing
species.summary: Kambing ternak (Capra aegagrus hircus) merupakan salah satu subspesies yang dipelihara atau dijinakkan dari kambing liar Asia Barat Daya dan Eropa Timur. Kambing merupakan anggota dari keluarga Bovidae dan bersaudara dengan biri-biri karena keduanya tergolong dalam sub famili Caprinae.
Graphium evemon, the blue jay, lesser jay, or pale green triangle is a species of tropical butterfly found in India, Indonesia, and Malaysia.
Platydemus manokwari, also known as the New Guinea flatworm, is a species of large predatory land flatworm.
Pyrops ruehli is a species of lanternfly.
Vindula erota, the common cruiser, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.
Cadlinella ornatissima is a species of sea slug or dorid nudibranch, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Chromodorididae.
Cepora nerissa, the common gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, China, Southeast Asia, and Indonesia.

Cytaea oreophila adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cytaea dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1902 oleh Simon.

Bapak pucung kapas atau bapak pucung tanda tiga (bahasa Latin: Dysdercus cingulatus) adalah spesies dari kepik sejati dalam famili Pyrrhocoridae. Bapak pucung kapas merupakan hama bagi tanaman kapas. Nimfa dewasa dan tua memakan buah kapas yang muncul dan biji kapas yang akan matang.
Erebus ephesperis is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in Asia, including India, Japan, the Korean Peninsula, China, Singapore and Borneo.
Pergesa acteus, the green pergesa hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae described by Pieter Cramer in 1779.

Eupterote asclepiades is a moth in the family Eupterotidae. It was described by Swinhoe in 1894. It is found in Sundaland. The habitat consist of lowland rainforests, including hill dipterocarp forests.
Xylocopa caerulea, the blue carpenter bee, is a species of carpenter bee.
Aegus chelifer, is a species of stag beetle found in Indo-Malaya regional countries.
Heteropoda tetrica is a species of huntsman spider in the genus Heteropoda. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1897.

Oriens gola, the common dartlet, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found from Sri Lanka and India (Kumaon, Sikkim, Assam) to Burma, Thailand, Vietnam, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo and Sumatra. The habitat consists of sunny glades and clearings in secondary forests and plantations.

Potanthus omaha, commonly known as the lesser dart, is a species of skipper butterflies. It is found in Indochina, Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Sulawesi. It includes the following subspecies:
Cethosia hypsea, the Malay lacewing, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in from Burma to Indonesia and the Philippines.
Lepas anserifera is a species of goose barnacle or stalked barnacle in the family Lepadidae. It lives attached to floating timber, ships' hulls and various sorts of flotsam.
Rapala pheretima, the copper flash, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Thaumantis odana, Malayan Jungle Glory, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Godart in 1824. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Dysdercus decussatus, the fork-banded cotton bug, is a species of true bug in the family Pyrrhocoridae and genus Dysdercus.

Gea spinipes adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1843 oleh C L Koch.
Papilio polytes, the common Mormon, is a common species of swallowtail butterfly widely distributed across Asia.

Bibasis sena, commonly known as the orange-tailed awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, the skippers. It is also sometimes called the pale green awlet though that name can also refer to Bibasis gomata.
Deroplatys desiccata, known by the common names giant dead leaf mantis is a species of praying mantis from Southeast Asia.

Dichorragia nesmachus, the constable, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia. The genus was earlier considered to belong to the subfamily Cyrestinae and sometimes the Apaturinae, but is now considered as an sister of the genus Stibochiona in the subfamily Pseudergolinae.
Eooxylides tharis, the branded imperial, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It was described by Carl Geyer in 1837. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Libythea myrrha, the club beak, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the Libytheinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Melanitis zitenius, the great evening brown, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia. The species is crepuscular.

species.name: Gangsir
species.summary: Gangsir (Tarbinskiellus portentosus, sin. Brachytrupes portentosus) adalah sejenis jangkrik besar yang hidup dengan menggali lubang di tanah. Jangkrik ini berpotensi sebagai hama tanaman pertanian, tetapi juga acap ditangkap untuk dikonsumsi orang.

Xanthotaenia is a monotypic butterfly genus in the family Nymphalidae. Its single species is Xanthotaenia busiris, the yellow-banded nymph. They can be identified by a yellow strip along their forewings.
Cethosia penthesilea, the orange lacewing, is a species of heliconiine butterfly found in Southeast Asia, as well as the Australia's Northern Territory.
Eurema sari, the chocolate grass yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Southeast Asia.
Belionota aenea is a Jewel Beetle of the Buprestidae family.

Eucorynus crassicornis is a species of fungus weevil in the beetle family Anthribidae, which was first described in 1801 by Johan Christian Fabricius as Anthribus crassicornis, from specimen(s) collected in Sumatra.

Glyphodes caesalis is a moth in the Crambidae family. It was described by Walker in 1859. It is found in Sri Lanka, mainland India, Burma, the Andaman Islands, New Guinea, Bangladesh, Fiji, Hong Kong, Thailand and Australia (Queensland).
Nacaduba beroe, the opaque six-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South Asia.
Serrognathus taurus is a species of beetle belonging to the family Lucanidae which was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1801.
Terinos terpander, the royal Assyrian, is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1862. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Tetraponera rufonigra, is a species of ant belonging to the subfamily Pseudomyrmecinae. It is distributed across Asia, and Africa. Commonly called the Bi-coloured Arboreal ant, they are arboreal and build small nests which are excavated holes usually in dried parts of trees.

Bibasis gomata, commonly known as the pale green awlet, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Northeast India, the Western Ghats and parts of Southeast Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara gomata.
Carrhotus sannio is a species of jumping spider in the family Salticidae. It is found across a wide range in Asia, from southern China to India, Indonesia and Guam.
Chalybion bengalense, also known as the oriental mud dauber, is a widely distributed member of the Chalybion genus. Melittobia assemi has been reported as a parasite of this species.
Hasora badra, the common awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in India.
Hypolimnas antilope, the spotted crow eggfly, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found from Malaya to the Philippines, New Guinea and Australia.
Athyma pravara, the unbroken sergeant, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.
Papilio forbesi is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is endemic to Sumatra.

Papilio palinurus, the emerald swallowtail, emerald peacock or green-banded peacock, is a butterfly of the genus Papilio belonging to the Papilionidae family. It is native to Southeast Asia, but is regularly kept in butterfly houses around the world.

species.name: Sumpil
species.summary: Subulina octona is a species of small, tropical, air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Subulinidae.
Anoplodesmus saussurii, is a species of millipedes in the family Paradoxosomatidae. It was once thought endemic to Sri Lanka, but later found from Fiji and Mauritius....

Dysphania militaris is a species of moth of the Geometridae family that is found from in the tropical regions of South and Southeast Asian countries such as China, Assam, Myanmar, Andaman Islands, Sumatra and Java.
Elymnias dara is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by William Burgess Pryer and William Lucas Distant in 1887. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Gandaca harina, the tree yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.

Hemithyrsocera palliata is a species of cockroach endemic to the South Asia. It has a shining dark brown color and is about 12 mm (1⁄2 in) long. Its pronotum is sub-elliptical and is black with a golden yellow margin.
Mormolyce phyllodes, commonly known as the violin Beetle, is a species of ground beetles in the subfamily Lebiinae.
Mycalesis orseis, atau kupu-kupu purple bushbrown, adalah kupu-kupu dari famili Nymphalidae. Kupu-kupu ini ditemukan di Asia Tenggara.
Polistes stigma is a species of paper wasp from Southeast Asia.
Ropalidia sumatrae, the Sumatran paper wasp, is a species of paper wasp in the subfamily Polistinae. It has been recorded in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam.
The two-striped jumper, or Telamonia dimidiata, is a jumping spider found in various Asian tropical rain forests, in foliage in wooded environments.
Amnosia decora, the Ninja, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Pseudergolinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is the sole member of the monotypic genus Amnosia.
Antheraea larissa is a silkworm moth of the family Saturniidae found in Sundaland. The species was first described by Westwood in 1847. The larva feed on the endangered tree Shorea glauca.
Pycnophallium elna, the elbowed Pierrot, is a small butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Hierodula dyaka is a species of praying mantis in the family Mantidae.

Acosmeryx shervillii, the dull forest hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from the Indian subregion of India, Sri Lanka, to Sundaland, the Philippines and Sulawesi. Acosmeryx pseudonaga is sometimes treated as a valid species.

Meandrusa payeni, the yellow gorgon, is a species of swallowtail found in parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the hooked swallowtails genus, Meandrusa, of the family Papilionidae. It is also called the outlet sword or the sickle.
Papilio paris, the Paris peacock, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.

Pystira ephippigera adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Pystira dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1885 oleh Simon.
Ambulyx pryeri is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Sundaland.
Asota paphos is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from the north-eastern Himalaya to Sundaland.

Culex quinquefasciatus Say, 1823 (originally named Culex fatigans), commonly known as the southern house mosquito, is a medium-sized mosquito found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world. It is the vector of Wuchereria bancrofti, avian malaria, and arboviruses including St.

Erebus macrops is a species of moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in the subtropical regions of Africa and Asia. The wingspan is about 12 cm, making it exceptionally large for an Erebidae species. The larvae feed on Acacia and Entada species.
Euploea crameri, the spotted black crow, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the Danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Heteropoda davidbowie is a species of huntsman spider of the Heteropoda genus. It was described from the Cameron Highlands District in peninsular Malaysia and named in honor of singer David Bowie.
Athyma selenophora, the staff sergeant, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.
Neritina turrita is a species of aquatic snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.

Xystrocera globosa adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong familia Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Xystrocera, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Zeuxidia aurelius, the giant Saturn, is a species of butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found in Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo.

Acosmeryx shervillii, the dull forest hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found from the Indian subregion of India, Sri Lanka, to Sundaland, the Philippines and Sulawesi. Acosmeryx pseudonaga is sometimes treated as a valid species.
Antheraea helferi is a moth of the family Saturniidae first described by Frederic Moore in 1858. It is found in the north-eastern Himalaya and Sundaland.
Kecoak jerman (Blattella germanica) adalah sebuah spesies kecoak kecil, umumnya memiliki panjang sekitar 1,1 hingga 1,6 cm (0,43 hingga 0,63 in). Warna bervariasi dari cokelat hingga hampir hitam.

Burmattus albopunctatus adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Burmattus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1895 oleh Thorell.

Celaenorrhinus ficulnea, the velvet flat, is a species of butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in south-east Asia. The typical form exhibits the white central spot of the forewing above and beneath straightly cut off by the lower median branch. In some taxonomic schemes (e.g.

Charaxes bernardus, the tawny rajah, is a butterfly that belongs to the rajahs and nawabs group, that is, the Charaxinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. This species can be found in India, China, Indomalaya, and onwards to Indonesia.
Coenobita cavipes is a species of land hermit crab native to the eastern parts of Africa, the Philippines, China, Japan, Malaysia, Taiwan, Polynesia, and Micronesia.
Delias aruna, the golden Jezebel, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Queensland, Irian Jaya, Maluku, Papua New Guinea and several surrounding islands.
Gangara thyrsis, commonly known as the giant redeye, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It breeds on a number of palm species.
Graphium macareus, the lesser zebra, is a relatively common and not threatened species of swallowtail butterfly found in Southeast Asia. It is also found in parts of India including Assam and Sikkim.
Hypolimnas pandarus is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. The species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae.
Ideopsis gaura, the smaller wood nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in Southeast Asia.

Iridomyrmex anceps is an ant species of the Iridomyrmex genus. It has a very large distribution in multiple continents, but it is mainly distributed in northern Australia. Some specimens were found in multiple islands, and some were even found and collected in the United Arab Emirates.
Rhipicephalus sanguineus merupakan ektoparasit umum yang sering menyerang anjing. Ektoparasit ini masuk dalam golongan caplak, sering dikelirukan dengan sebutan kutu.
Tachypompilus analis, the red-tailed spider wasp is a species of spider wasp found in most of tropical and subtropical Asia, north to Japan. These spider wasps often hunt huntsman spiders.

Tenodera aridifolia is a species of mantis in the subfamily Mantinae. Common names include Japanese giant mantis, オオカマキリ oo-kamakiri ("large mantis") in Japan. It is also known as the Chinese mantis, not to be confused with Tenodera sinensis, which has the same common name. T.
Thaumantis klugius is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Johann Zincken in 1831. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Zythos turbata is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in southern Burma and on Borneo, Sumatra, Java, Peninsular Malaysia and the Philippines (Mindanao, Mindoro, Palawan, Tawi Tawi Island).
Ambulyx canescens is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in Indochina, Malaysia, Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the Philippines.

Kupu-kupu biblis atau Cethosia biblis adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu subfamili Heliconiinae yang termasuk dari famili Nymphalidae. Spesies ini tersebar di bagian timur Anak Benua India hingga ke Asia Tenggara dan Asia Timur. Batas paling timur hingga Filipina dan batas paling selatan hingga Indonesia.
Cirrochroa emalea, the malay yeoman, is an Indomalayan species of heliconiine butterfly described by Félix Édouard Guérin-Méneville in 1843.
The Hodgson's hawk-cuckoo (Hierococcyx nisicolor), also known as the whistling hawk-cuckoo is a species of cuckoo found in north-eastern India, Myanmar, southern China and southeast Asia.
Dideopsis aegrota is a species of hover fly in the family Syrphidae. It is found in South Korea, China, India, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Nepal, as well as eastern Australia.

Dotilla myctiroides is a species of sand bubbler crab found on sea coasts in tropical Asia and East Asia, from Karachi to Japan. They breed throughout the year but activity peaks during the monsoons. This species builds a burrow, called an "igloo", in unstable sand as well as in well-drained and firm sand.
Elymnias panthera, the tawny palmfly, is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1787. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Euploea camaralzeman is an Indomalayan species of danaine butterfly.
Graphium bathycles, the veined jay, is a butterfly in the family Papilionidae, that is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Kallima paralekta, the Indian leafwing or Malayan leafwing, is a species of brush-footed butterfly of the genus Kallima. Despite its common names, it is not found in India or Malaysia, but is endemic to Java and Sumatra of Indonesia.
Nerita balteata is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.
Tagiades gana, the immaculate snow flat, large snow flat or suffused snow flat, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Teleogryllus mitratus is a species of field cricket in the family Gryllidae. It belongs to the genus Teleogryllus, a group of crickets known for their loud calling songs and widespread distribution across Asia and Oceania.
The Malaysian moon moth (Actias maenas) is a Saturniid in the subfamily Saturniinae from Indomalaya. The male is purplish-brown and yellow, while the larger female is overall light green.
Argiope chloreis is a species of orb-weaver spider in the family Araneidae. It was first described by Swedish arachnologist Tamerlan Thorell in 1877.

Curbia is a monotypic moth genus in the family Geometridae described by Warren in 1894. Its single species, Curbia martiata, described by Achille Guenée in 1857, is found in Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Borneo.

Gryllotalpa orientalis is a species of mole cricket in the family Gryllotalpidae, commonly known as the oriental mole cricket. It is found in much of Asia and also in Australasia. At one time this species was misidentified as G.

Idea leuconoe, the paper kite, rice paper or large tree nymph, is known especially for its presence in butterfly houses and live butterfly expositions. It has a wingspan of 12 to 14 cm. The paper kite is of Southeast Asian origin, but can also be found in Northern Australia and Southern Taiwan.

Lamproptera curius, the white dragontail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly native to parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the dragontails genus, Lamproptera, of the swallowtail (Papilionidae) family. It is not rare.

species.summary: Mocis trifasciata is a moth of the Erebidae family. It is found in the south-west Pacific region, including Samoa, Fiji, Hawaii, New Zealand, the Society Islands and Queensland.

Parantica luzonensis, also commonly known as the Luzon glassy tiger, is a species of tiger butterfly that belongs to the family of brush-footed butterflies. This species has a wide range being found in Southeast Asia including Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippine Islands among other places.
Phaesticus mellerborgi is a groundhopper found in China, Indo-China and Malesia, now placed incertae sedis the Tetrigidae.
Poritia erycinoides, the blue gem, is a small butterfly found in India, Myanmar and parts of South-East Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Rhynchophorus bilineatus, common name Black Palm Weevil, is a species of beetles belonging to the family Curculionidae.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.
Terinos clarissa is an Indomalayan is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Heliconiinae). The larva feed on Homalium, Rinorea

Triacanthus nieuhofii, the silver tripodfish, is a species of marine ray-finned fish belonging to the family Triacanthidae, the triplespines or tripodfishes. This species is found in the Indo-West Pacific region.

Acrida cinerea, the Chinese grasshopper, is a member of the Acrididae family. Like other members of the genus Acrida, Acrida cinerea lacks stridulatory organs on its legs and so they do not make noise whilst moving.

Barbodes sellifer, the saddled barb, is a species of cyprinid fish described in 2021. This species has not been reported sold in the aquarium trade, but where the species is present reports of them being kept by aquarists are abundant.
Drupadia theda, the dark posy, is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1862. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Euploea eyndhovii, the striped black crow, is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Eurema simulatrix, the changeable grass yellow, is a butterfly in the Pieridae family. It is found from Burma to Sundaland and the Philippines. The habitat consists of secondary or disturbed habitats including forest clearings, roadsides and riverbanks, parks and gardens.

Gasteracantha doriae adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Simon....

Iambrix stellifer, the starry bob or Malay chestnut bob, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in southern Burma, Laos, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore, as well as on Borneo, Sumatra, Nias, Java, Batoe and Mentawi. The habitat consists of forested lowland areas.
Koruthaialos sindu, the bright red velvet bob, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. The species was first described by father and son entomologists Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1860.
Leptopoma perlucidum is a species of land snail with a gill and an operculum, a terrestrial gastropod mollusk in the family Cyclophoridae.

Lethocerus indicus is a giant water bug in the family Belostomatidae, native to South and Southeast Asia, as well as southeast China, Korea, the Ryukyu Islands and New Guinea. It was originally described as Belostoma indicum but is no longer placed in that genus.
Mooreana trichoneura, the yellow flat, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and subfamily Pyrginae (flats). It has a wingspan of 32–36 mm.
Odontolabis dalmani is a species of beetles belonging to the family Lucanidae.

Phrynarachne decipiens, the bird-dropping spider, is a species of tropical crab spider from Malaysia and Indonesia (Sumatra and Java). It mimics a bird dropping in its appearance and the way it behaves.
Xanthodes transversa, the transverse moth' or hibiscus caterpillar, is a moth of the family Nolidae. The species was first described by Achille Guenée in 1852.
Asota strigosa is a moth of the family Erebidae first described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1832. It is found in Indonesia and the Papua New Guinea.
Atactodea striata, common name striated beach clam or striated little trough shell, is a species of surf clam, a marine bivalve mollusk in the family Mesodesmatidae.

Zeugodacus tau (syn. Bactrocera tau), the pumpkin fruit fly or the tau fruit fly, is a species of fruit fly in the family Tephritidae. The species is native to tropical and subtropical Asia. It is a major pest species of melons and other cucurbits.

Catharsius molossus adalah spesies kumbang yang berasal dari genus Catharsius dan famili Scarabaeidae. Kumbang ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.
Choaspes plateni, the branded awlking, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in Asia.

Curetis insularis is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It is found in the Indomalayan realm (Java, Peninsular Malaya, Borneo, Sumatra, Thailand). Curetis insularis was described by Horsfield in 1829.
Cyclommatus canaliculatus is a species of beetles belonging to the family Lucanidae.
Cyclosia panthona is a moth in the family Zygaenidae. It was described by Caspar Stoll in 1780. It is found in China, Hong Kong, India, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar.
Hemiplecta humphreysiana is a species of air-breathing land snails, terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusks in the family Ariophantidae.

Hymenia perspectalis, the spotted beet webworm moth, is a species of moth of the Crambidae family. It is found in various parts of the world, including North America, where it is found from Maine to Florida, west to Texas and north to Michigan and Ontario.
Idea lynceus, the tree-nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia.

Lelemah (Lactarius lactarius) adalah jenis ikan yang saat ini merupakan satu-satunya spesies dalam famili Lactariidae. Ikan ini juga dikenal sebagai Ikan Susu; Lapa Iaai; Kapas-Kapas; Babete Lubangan; Tambi-Tambi; Budo; Ramas; Lemah Susu; Selah; Klemes; Silea; Ikan Batang; Raramas.

Lasippa tiga, the Burmese lascar, is an Indomalayan butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It was first described by Frederic Moore in 1858. The larva feeds on Cratoxylon species (shrubs or small to medium-sized trees).
Miletus symethus, the great brownie, is a small butterfly found in India that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Mycalesis fuscum, the Malayan bush brown, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, Java, Borneo, and Nias.

Serrognathus titanus is a species of beetle in the family Lucanidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1835. Huang and Chen (2013) separated Serognathus from the genus Dorcus by representing morphological characters and DNA analysis.

Statilia maculata, common name Asian jumping mantis or "小蟷螂", ko-kamakiri (Japanese meaning "small mantis") or "좀사마귀", joem-sa-ma-gui (Korean meaning "small mantis"), is a species of praying mantis native to Asia that can be found in China and Japan and Korea.

Stenomelania plicaria, commonly known as the chopstick snail or the yellow chopstick snail, is a species of trumpet snail, first described by I. von Born under the synonymized name Helix pilcaria (Index rerum naturalium Musei Cæsarei Vindobonensis (pg. 403)).

Strongylura strongylura, the spottail needlefish or blackspot longtom, is a species of needlefish from the family Belonidae. It is found in the Indian and western Pacific Oceans from the Persian Gulf east to Australia and the Philippines.
Tetragonus lycaenoides is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is found in Sulawesi, Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Nias.

Theretra alecto, known as the Levant hawk moth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is found in the Indomalaya ecozone and warm parts of the Palearctic ecozone, including extreme south-eastern Europe.
Appias indra, the plain puffin, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.

Appias paulina, the common albatross, Christmas Island white or Ceylon lesser albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found from India to Samoa, including Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Caledonia, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Australia.

Archigenes aita is a butterfly in the family Riodinidae. It is found on both Sumatra and Borneo. It was first described by British entomologist Lionel de Nicéville in 1893. A phylogenetic analysis led to its being moved out of the genus Abisara.
Deroplatys truncata is a species of praying mantis in the genus Deroplatys in the order Mantodea.

Euagoras plagiatus is a species of assassin bugs (insects in the family Reduviidae), in the subfamily Harpactorinae. It has been investigated as a potential biocontrol agent for Pterophorus lienigianus Z., which is a pest of eggplant (Solanum melongena).
Eurypteryx bhaga is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Graphium cloanthus, the glassy bluebottle, is a common, non-threatened tropical butterfly of the family Papilionidae.

The Dussumier's halfbeak (Hyporhamphus dussumieri) lives in reefs and shallow lagoons. They live solitary or in groups, and are often seen circling snorkelers, just under the surface of the water. The longest known specimen was 38.0 cm in length.

Neogurelca hyas is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from India, Nepal, Myanmar, central and southern China, Taiwan, southern Japan, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia (Peninsular), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java) and the Philippines.
Oliva vidua, common name the black olive, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Olividae, the olives.
Papilio iswaroides is a species of swallowtail butterfly from the genus Papilio that is found in Malaysia and Sumatra. It was first described by German entomologist Hans Fruhstorfer in 1898.
Athyma kanwa, the dot-dash sergeant, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.

Polybioides raphigastra is a species of social wasp found in the forests of South East Asia and Indonesia. It has recently been placed in the tribe Ropalidiini. This species is known for the downward-spiraling shape of their nests, and for having colony sizes exceeding ten thousand members.
Rhombodera basalis is a species of praying mantis of the genus Rhombodera. Its commons name is the giant Asian shield mantis. This insect has been known to grow up 120mm in captivity.
Sithon nedymond, the plush, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Hans Fruhstorfer in 1912. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Allorhynchium argentatum is a species of wasp in the Vespidae family.
Amathuxidia amythaon, the koh-i-noor, is a butterfly found in Asia. It belongs to the Morphinae, a subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies.
Caplak kerbau (Amblyomma testudinarium) adalah sebuah spesies caplak berbadan keras dari genus Amblyomma. Spesies tersebut ditemukan di Indonesia, India, Jepang, Thailand, Sri Lanka dan Vietnam.

Aporandria specularia is a species of moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Vietnam, Thailand, the Andamans, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo, the Philippines and Sulawesi.
Appias cardena, the yellow puffin, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1861. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Appias pandione is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Carl Geyer in 1832. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Blattella asahinai, atau kecoak asia, adalah sebuah spesies kecoak yang pertamakali dideskripsikan pada 1981 dari serangga-serangga yang dikumpulkan di Pulau Okinawa, Jepang.

species.summary: Cirrochroa orissa, the banded yeoman, is an Indomalayan species of heliconiine butterfly described by Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1860.
Discophora necho, the blue duffer, is a species of butterfly in the duffers group, that is, the Morphinae subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Dolichoderus cuspidatus is a species of ant in the genus Dolichoderus. Described by Smith in 1857, the species is endemic to Borneo, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand.
Enpinanga borneensis is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Thailand, Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan) and the Philippines (Palawan).
Eucorysses grandis is a species of shield-backed bugs belonging to the tribe Scutellerini.
Euploea midamus, the blue spotted crow, is a butterfly found in India and South-East Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

Gasteracantha mengei adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1864 oleh Keyserling.

Henosepilachna pusillanima is a species is a species of beetle in the Coccinellidae family. It is found in Taiwan, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Like others in the Henosepilachna genus, the species is herbivorous. It feeds primarily on plants in the Solanaceae family.

species.name: Kedukang
species.summary: Kedukang, kedukan, keropak, atau ikan duri (Hexanematichthys sagor) adalah sejenis ikan manyung yang biasa didapati di tepi pantai berlumpur dan kuala sungai.
Jamides pura, the white cerulean, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It was described by Frederic Moore in 1886. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Lethe mekara, the common red forester, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia.
Lophyra fuliginosa is a species of tiger beetle found in China, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam, Malaysia and Indonesia (including Borneo).
Mariaella dussumieri is a species of air-breathing land slug, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Ariophantidae.

Microhyla nakkavaram is a species of narrow-mouthed frog in the family Microhylidae. It was described as a new species in 2022 from the Nicobar Islands of India. The species is known from the southern group of the Nicobar Islands, including Great Nicobar, Kondul, and Little Nicobar.
Papilio iswara, the great Helen, is a species of large swallowtail butterfly found in parts of Southeast Asia.
Petrelaea dana, the dingy lineblue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Asia.

Bubukom (Polyrhachis bihamata) adalah spesies semut yang perdana dideskripsikan secara ilmiah oleh Dru Drury pada tahun 1773. Serangga ini tergolong dalam genus Polyrhachis. Sejauh ini belum ada subspesies dari bubukom yang teridentifikasi.

Zeuxidia amethystus, the common Saturn, is a species of butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1865. This butterfly is relatively large and striking. Its forewings have a broad iridescent-blue band with a similar blue patch on the hindwing.

The Asian monitor lizard tick, (Amblyomma varanense) is a hard-bodied tick of the genus Amblyomma. It is found in India, Thailand, Taiwan and Sri Lanka. Adults parasitize various reptiles such as varanids and snakes. These ticks are potential vectors of spotted fever group (SFG) rickettsiae.
Amphidromus enganoensis is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae....
Cepora julia is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found on Sumba and Sumbawa.
Cepora nadina, the lesser gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, Myanmar, Hainan, and Southeast Asia.

Kepiting cuka ungu (Episesarma versicolor) adalah spesies kepiting perenang dalam genus Episesarma. Tersebar di seluruh perairan laut dan payau di wilayah Indo-Barat Pasifik. Kepiting ini ditangkap oleh banyak nelayan lokal sebagai sumber makanan kaya protein.

Euploea alcathoe, commonly known as the no-brand crow, Eichhorn's crow or striped black crow, is a common butterfly found from India to Borneo, and in the Moluccas, New Guinea and Australia. It belongs to the crows and tigers subfamily of the Nymphalidae (brushfooted butterflies).
Euploea klugii, the brown king crow, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Euthalia kanda is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Limenitidinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Ficus ficus or the paper fig shell is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Ficidae, the fig shells.
Hasora leucospila is a species of butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in Southeast Asia, Cambodia.
Helvia is a genus of praying mantises in the family Hymenopodidae found in Southeast Asia. It is monotypic, being represented by the single species, Helvia cardinalis.
Hexarthrius mandibularis is one of the world's largest stag beetle. It belongs to the tribe Lucanini, in the family Lucanidae.

Idea idea, or Linnaeus' idea, is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Carl Linnaeus in his 1763 Centuria Insectorum. It is found in the Australasian realm.

Iraota rochana, the scarce silverstreak, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly with several subspecies found in (Manipur, Burma, Java, Borneo, Sumatra, Malaya, Langkawi, Thailand, Singapore, Sulawesi and the Philippines.
Kallima spiridiva is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found on Sumatra in Indonesia. It is only active during the daytime, and has a hearing range of 1200 hertz.

Menemerus brachygnathus is a genus of jumping spider. It is known as shirahige-haetori (シラヒゲハエトリ(白髭蠅捕)) in Japan, meaning 'white-bearded jumping spider', due to the white trichobothria (hair-like structures) on its limbs and body.
Mycalesis oroatis is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in South-east Asia.
Neptis anjana, the rich sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.

Neptis miah, the small yellow sailer, is a nymphalid butterfly found in India, Bhutan, Thailand, and Malaysia eastward to western China, Hainan and Guangdong. Seven subspecies have been identified. The Guangdong subspecies belongs to N. miah disopa Swinhoe and the Hainan subspecies is considered as N.
Odontolabis gazella is a species of beetle belonging to the family Lucanidae.
Pantoporia paraka, the Perak lascar, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.
Pictocolumbella ocellata, common name : the lightning dove shell, is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Columbellidae, the dove snails.
Platerodrilus ngi is a species of net-winged beetle (Lycidae), which, as with other members of the genus, is considered a trilobite beetle.

Polyura delphis, the jewelled nawab, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the rajahs and nawabs group, that is, the Charaxinae subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies family. This butterfly has multiple red spots bordered by yellow bands on a metallic white background.
