species.summary: Pulchriphyllium bioculatum, or Gray's leaf insect, is a leaf insect of the family Phylliidae native to tropical Asia as well as Madagascar, Mauritius and the Seychelles. It was first described by George Robert Gray in 1832, which was his first phasmid he discovered.
Ravanoa is a genus of moths of the Crambidae family. It contains only one species, Ravanoa xiphialis, which is found in Sri Lanka, Burma and on Borneo.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.
Telicota augias, the bright-orange darter, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in Australia, Papua New Guinea, Myanmar, Indonesia and the Philippines.
Tubuca rosea, also known by its common name rose fiddler crab, is a species of crab from the genus Tubuca.

Vespa mocsaryana, the Mocsarian hornet, is a species of hornet endemic to far eastern India, parts of China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, Laos, Thailand, and Vietnam. It was described by Robert du Buysson in 1905. The species was named after the village of Mocsa, Hungary.

Adaina microdactyla is a moth of the family Pterophoridae. It has a wide distribution and is known from the Palearctic ecozone (from Europe to Korea, Japan and China), Asia Minor, Iran, Vietnam, the Solomon Islands, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.
Amphidromus sumatranus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.

Anematichthys is a monotypic genus of ray-finned fish in the family Cyprinidae containing a single valid species, Anematichthys repasson. It is native to freshwater habitats in Asia: Mekong and Chao Phraya basins, Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Java and Borneo. The species was formerly classified as Cyclocheilichthys.
Apalacris varicornis is a species of grasshopper in the family Acrididae. It is found in Indomalaya and has been recorded as a minor agricultural pest in Thailand and Malaysia.

Arhopala atosia is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1869. It is found in Southeast Asia - Borneo, Sumatra, Bangka, Pulau Laut (A. a. atosia), Thailand, Indochina, Peninsular Malaya, Singapore (A. a. malayana Bethune-Baker, 1903), Burma (A. a.
Biston pustulata is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found in China (Hainan), southern Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia and Sundaland.
Chersonesia peraka is an Indomalayan butterfly of the family Nymphalidae (Cyrestinae). It is found in the Indomalayan realm from Burma to Malaysia and on to Java, Bali, Borneo, Sumatra and Nias.

Choaspes subcaudata, commonly known as the blue awlking, is a species of butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Asia, Malaysia and Borneo. The species was first described by Baron Cajetan von Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1867.
Cirrochroa satellita is an Indomalayan species of heliconiine butterfly.
Euploea modesta is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1866. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Eurema lacteola, the scarce grass yellow, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India, Peninsular Malaya, Java, Sumatra and Borneo.

Euscyrtus concinnus, sometimes called long horned cricket, is a species of cricket found in South and Southeast Asia, including Sri Lanka, India, Bangladesh, Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Borneo, Sulawesi), Thailand, and Vietnam.
Euthalia alpheda is an Indomalayan butterfly of the Nymphalidae family (Limenitidinae).
Graphium agetes, the fourbar swordtail, is a widespread species of swallowtail butterfly found in tropical Asia. It is common and not threatened.
Graphium ramaceus, the Pendlebury's zebra, is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae (swallowtails). It is found in parts of the Indomalaya ecozone.
Hasora vitta, the plain banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and parts of Southeast Asia.

Idea hypermnestra is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1848. It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is found in Thailand and Malaysia.
Ixias pyrene, the yellow orange tip, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.
Jamides zebra is a butterfly of the lycaenids or blues family first described by Hamilton Herbert Druce in 1895. It is found in South-east Asia.
Laringa castelnaui is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.
Lethe chandica, the angled red forester, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm.
Lethe rohria, the common treebrown, is a species of satyrine butterfly found in Asia.
Longicella mollis is a species of moth of the family Noctuidae first described by Francis Walker in 1856.
Lophozozymus pictor, the mosaic reef crab is a species of crab in the family Xanthidae.
Nacaduba calauria, the dark Ceylon six-lineblue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in South Asia.

Notocrypta curvifascia, the restricted demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. N. curvifascia is commonly found in many regions of temperate and tropical East Asia, Indonesia, and the Indian subcontinent, wherever its preferred larval host plant, Alpinia nutans can be found.

Ogdenia is a genus of the jumping spiders endemic to Sarawak, Borneo. As of 2017, it contains only one species, Ogdenia mutilla. Peckham Peckham regarded the species as being close to Hasarius. The female epigyne was drawn by Proszynsky (1984).
Ophisma pallescens is a moth of the family Noctuidae first described by Francis Walker in 1864. It is found in Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo, Sulawesi, Seram and New Guinea.

Papilio (Chilasa) paradoxa, the great blue mime, is a swallowtail butterfly found in India and parts of South-East Asia. The butterfly belongs to the mime subgenus, Chilasa, of the genus Papilio (black-bodied swallowtails). It is an excellent mimic of different species of Euploea (sub-family Danainae).

species.name: Udang windu
species.summary: Penaeus monodon atau giant tiger prawn,Asian tiger shrimp, black tiger shrimp, adalah sebuah crustaces yang dibudidayakan secara luas untuk dikunsumsi.

species.summary: Appias aegis, the forest white, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in south-east Asia.
Poecilopsyra is a monotypic genus of katydids or bush crickets native to Malesia. The single (type) species, Poecilopsyra octoseriata, was originally taken from Borneo.
Polyura jalysus is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1867. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Pyrops pyrorhynchus is a species of lanternfly of the family Fulgoridae. It is found in India, Thailand, and Malaysia.

Scutigera coleoptrata, also known as the house centipede, is a species of centipede that is typically yellowish-gray and has up to 15 pairs of long legs. Originating in the Mediterranean region, it has spread to other parts of the world, where it frequently lives in and around human homes.
Theretra suffusa is a moth of the family Sphingidae.
Vespa bellicosa, the warlike hornet, is a rare species of hornet endemic to the lowland tropical forests of Borneo and Sumatra. It was described by Henri Louis Frédéric de Saussure in 1854.
Vittina gagates is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.
Abisara kausambi, the straight plum Judy, is a small but striking butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm that belongs to the Punches and Judies, that is, the family Riodinidae.

Agatasa is a butterfly genus in the brush-footed butterflies family (Nymphalidae). It is monotypic, containing only Agatasa calydonia, the glorious begum, which is found from southern Burma, through the Thai-Malay Peninsula, to Borneo, Sumatra and the Philippines.
Algia fasciata is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in Asia.

Altica cyanea is a species of flea beetle. It is a pest of millets such as sorghum in India. It is being investigated as a biological pest control of Ludwigia adscendens, a common weed in rice fields.
Amantis nawai is a small species of praying mantis native to Eastern Asia. Amantis nawai are parthenogenetic, and males are uncommonly seen.

Ariadne merione, the common castor, is an orange butterfly with brown lines whose larvae feed almost exclusively on castor (Ricinus communis). It is similar in appearance to Ariadne ariadne, the angled castor.

species.name: Kekep Babi
species.summary: Kekep babi (bahasa Latin: Artamus leucorynchus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Artamidae, dari genus Artamus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, kumbang, leba dan memiliki habitat di pesisir, sawah, kebun, tegalan, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.
Auzakia is a monotypic butterfly genus in the family Nymphalidae. It contains the single species, Auzakia danava, the commodore, which is found from Tibet to Sumatra.
Bibasis etelka, the great orange awlet, is a species of skipper described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1871.
Bibasis harisa, the orange awlet, is a species of hesperid found in Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara harisa.
Bythopsyrna circulata is a species of Asian planthoppers belonging to the family Flatidae.
Celaenorrhinus asmara, the white-banded flat, is a hesperiid butterfly which is found in South and Southeast Asia.
Charaxes borneensis is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1869. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Cornu aspersum (syn. Helix aspersa, Cryptomphalus aspersus), dikenal dengan nama umum siput kebun atau siput taman, adalah sebuah spesies siput darat dalam famili Helicidae, yang mencakup beberapa jenis siput darat yang paling familiar.

Curetis santana is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It was described by Moore in 1857. It is found in Southeast Asia (Burma, Indochina, Peninsular Malaya, Thailand, Sumatra, Bangka and Borneo).

Cyclommatus elaphus is a species of the genus Cyclommatus from Indonesia. It is also the largest species of the genus Cyclommatus and can grow up to a maximum of 109 mm (4.29 inches) from the tip of the mandibles to the end of the abdomen.

Dysphania subrepleta is a species of false tiger moth (genus Dysphania) in the subfamily Geometrinae. Records are from Indo-China and western Malesia including Borneo, with no subspecies listed in the Catalogue of Life, where it is a "provisionally accepted name".

Eetion elia, the white-spot palmer, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1866. It is found in Malaysia and Singapore, as well as on Sumatra and Borneo. The habitat consists of fringes of secondary forests.
Enpinanga vigens is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from southern Thailand, Malaysia (Peninsular, Sarawak), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan) and the Philippines.
Erionota sybirita is a species of Indomalayan butterfly of the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Malaysia, Burma, Thailand, Borneo and Palawan.

Eurema ada, the Talbot's Grass Yellow, is a species of butterfly in the genus Eurema. It was discovered in northern Borneo and described in 1871. Its main distinctive features are that its ground color is pale sulfurous, not white, and the border margins on its wings are blacker and wider. Wingspan is 35 mm.
Gekko cicakterbang, the Malaysia parachute gecko, is a species of gecko. It is found in Malaysia.

Graphium arycles, the spotted jay, is a species of butterfly of the family Papilionidae found in the Indomalayan ecozone. It is scarce and likely to be found in the extreme north east of India. It is not known to be threatened but the nominate subspecies is protected by law in India.
Gryllotalpa africana, also known as the African mole cricket, is a relatively small mole cricket species, native to Africa, but local populations exist in Asia, and southern Europe.
Harpalus rufipes is a species of ground beetle in the subfamily Harpalinae. It was described by Degeer in 1774. Harpalus rufipes is native to Europe....
Hasora khoda, the large banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India, parts of Southeast Asia and Australia.
Kaniska canace, the blue admiral, is a nymphalid butterfly, the only species of the genus Kaniska.
Ledra aurita is a species of bug in the family Cicadellidae. It is the only species of the subfamily Ledrinae that lives in Europe and the United Kingdom.
Liphistius sumatranus is a species of spider in the subfamily Liphistiinae of the family Liphistiidae, native to Sumatra in Indonesia.

species.summary: Loxura cassiopeia is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family.It was described by William Lucas Distant in 1884. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Meretrix meretrix, commonly known as the Asiatic hard clam, is a species of saltwater bivalve in the family Veneridae.
Mimathyma ambica, the Indian purple emperor, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.

Moduza procris, the commander, sometimes included in the genus Limenitis, is a medium-sized, strikingly coloured brush-footed butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It is notable for the mode of concealment employed by its caterpillar and the cryptic camouflage of its pupa.

Mycalesis perseoides, atau kupu-kupu Pachmarhi bushbrown, adalah spesies kupu-kupu satyrine (famili Nymphalidae) yang ditemukan di Asia (Burma, Thailand, Pulau Langkawi, Semenanjung Malaya, Indochina, Yunnan, India) yang pertama kali dideskripsikan pada 1892.

species.summary: Naria eburnea, common name ivory cowry, is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Neoferdina cumingi, also known as Cuming's sea star, is a species of starfish in the family Goniasteridae. It is native to the tropical Indo-Pacific region.
Neptis nata, the clear sailer or dirty sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia.

Olenecamptus siamensis adalah spesies kumbang tanduk panjang yang tergolong famili Cerambycidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Olenecamptus, ordo Coleoptera, kelas Insecta, filum Arthropoda, dan kingdom Animalia.

Oratosquilla oratoria is a species of mantis shrimp found in the Western Pacific. It is widely harvested in Japan where it is known as shako (シャコ, 蝦蛄) and eaten as sushi. Like other members of its order it has a powerful spear, which it uses to hunt invertebrates and small fish.
Parantica melaneus, the chocolate tiger, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Paratoxodera meggitti is a species of praying mantis found in southern China, Myanmar, West Malaysia, and Borneo.

The Indian prawn (Fenneropenaeus indicus, formerly Penaeus indicus) is one of the major commercial prawn species of the world. It is found in the Indo-West Pacific from eastern and south-eastern Africa, through India, Malaysia and Indonesia to southern China and northern Australia.
Porcellionides pruinosus is a cosmopolitan woodlouse that is native to Europe, and is suspected to consist of very closely related species. Ten subspecies are recognised.
Pseudocoladenia dan, the fulvous pied flat, is an Indomalayan butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Rhombodera fratricida is a species of praying mantises in the family Mantidae, found in Indomalaya.
Subdoluseps samajaya is a species of skink found in Sarawak, Borneo (Malaysia).

The black-bellied hornet, or Vespa basalis, is a species of hornet native to Taiwan. It is one of the most dangerous species of hornet on the island, and its venom induces edema. Colonies may have as many as 5,000 individual hornets.
Xanthocryptus novozealandicus, the lemon tree borer parasite, is a wasp in the family Ichneumonidae. It is a native insect of New Zealand. It is also found in Australia and New Guinea.

Xenocatantops humilis is the type species of grasshoppers in its genus of the family Acrididae and subfamily Catantopinae. This species can be found in India, Indo-China, Malesia (the type locality is Java), and Papua New Guinea.
Xenochroa xanthia is a moth of the Nolidae family. It is found in the north-eastern parts of the Himalaya, Singapore, Sumatra, Borneo and Palawan. It is found in lowland forests.
